text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 133, December 29, 1937 ]
CONFIRMING THE ELECTION OF PROVINCIAL AND CITY OFFICERS ELECTED ON DECEMBER
14, 1937
Each of the persons named below having been certified by the provincial and municipal boards of canvassers
to have received a plurality of the votes legally cast at the ordinary election held in the provinces and cities on
the fourteenth day of December, nineteen hundred and thirty-seven, under the provisions of the new Election
Law, and there being in my opinion no reason why their elections should not be confirmed, the said election
are, pursuant to the recommendation of the Secretary of the Interior, hereby confirmed in accordance with the
section four hundred seventy-two of the new Election Law:
